cd0be92386a78752.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Life Guard to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the safety of swimmers and maintaining a comfortable environment for guests within the designated swimming area. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor the designated swimming area for dangerous situations, unusual activities, and swimmers in distress. Utilize appropriate rescue techniques when swimmers require assistance. Promote and enforce recreational facility rules and regulations. Identify situations where guests cannot safely participate in an activity and report to a supervisor/manager. Provide assistance to injured guests until emergency medical services arrive. Maintain a joyful and comfortable environment for all guests. Perform tasks such as taking, folding, and stacking towels according to company procedures. Wash, scrub, and clean the pool deck area. Report accidents, injuries, and hazardous working conditions to management; participate in safety training and obtain relevant certifications. Operational Duties and Physical Requirements Comply with all company safety policies and procedures; report maintenance issues, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are neat and professional. Maintain the privacy of company property information and protect company assets. Support co-workers and treat them with dignity and respect; contribute to team goals. Meet quality assurance expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than 50 pounds ( kg) independently, and assist with objects weighing more than 75 pounds ( kg). Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or for the entire work shift; move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, running, walking, jogging). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of various sizes and weights, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting at the waist, crawling, and leaning. Move on inclined, uneven, or slippery surfaces and stairs; climb up and down ladders and service ramps. Greet and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; communicate professionally and answer phone calls appropriately. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors. Qualifications and Requirements High school diploma or equivalent General Educational Development (GED) certificate. No related work experience required. No supervisory experience required. Mandatory Skills and Certifications Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certification. First Aid certification. Proficiency with physical fitness equipment. Any certification or training required by local and state agencies.

The role requires a commercially driven engineering professional with a strong technical background and a proven track record in business development and key account management. Role Overview The Technical Sales Engineer will be responsible for driving technical sales solutions within the Saudi market. This involves identifying new business opportunities, expanding the client portfolio, and managing relationships with customers and partners. The successful candidate will leverage in-depth product knowledge to provide technical recommendations and manage the sales process from inquiry to deal closure and payment collection. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities across the Saudi market. Proactively approach potential customers to expand the company's client portfolio. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and business partners. Understand technical requirements, prepare RFQs and commercial quotations, and drive negotiations through to deal closure. Develop in-depth knowledge of technical products and solutions to provide appropriate customer recommendations. Negotiate pricing and commercial terms while maintaining targeted profit margins. Monitor sales pipelines, customer activities, forecasts, and business performance through CRM systems. Follow up on customer payments and ensure timely collection. The role involves active engagement with clients and partners across the Saudi market. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cd411781233a5803.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جزيرة سماء للأزياء عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم تجربة مبيعات ممتازة للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة عن المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات شاملة ودقيقة حول المنتجات، استخداماتها، وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام وضمان ترتيب المتجر بشكل مستمر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على شرح تفاصيل المنتجات بوضوح. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل جزيرة سماء للأزياء في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والعمل ضمن بيئة مبيعات ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يمتلكون الشغف لتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة والانضمام إلى فريقنا.

cda77f776a617340.description: About the Role Marafiq is seeking a Specialist, Digital Transformation Projects to join their team in Yanbu, Eastern region. This full-time role involves coordinating and monitoring the execution of digital transformation projects, ensuring they align with approved scope, schedule, budget, governance requirements, and strategic objectives. The specialist will play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of business outcomes through these projects. Project Coordination and Monitoring The primary purpose of this position is to oversee and track digital transformation initiatives. This includes ensuring that projects are delivered against approved objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards. The specialist will be responsible for tracking progress, milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, and dependencies, providing regular status updates and recommendations to stakeholders. Track project progress, milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, and dependencies, providing timely status updates and recommendations. Coordinate with Project Team Leaders, business units, technology teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to facilitate effective project execution and issue resolution. Monitor project expenditures, commitments, forecasts, and payment milestones against approved budgets, highlighting variances for corrective action. Prepare and maintain project documentation, dashboards, reports, presentations, and records to support governance and management decision-making. Apply approved project governance frameworks, methodologies, standards, and reporting requirements across assigned initiatives. Support Project Team Leaders in resolving project delivery constraints and identifying practical, cost-effective solutions. Monitor project risks and issues, maintain risk registers, and follow up on mitigation and corrective action plans. Support stakeholder engagement, communication, and change management activities to facilitate user adoption and realization of project benefits. A strong understanding of project governance frameworks, methodologies, and reporting requirements is essential. Required Skills Proficiency in project coordination and monitoring. Ability to track project progress, risks, and issues effectively. Strong coordination and communication skills for engaging with diverse stakeholders. Competence in budget monitoring and variance analysis. Skill in preparing comprehensive project documentation and reports. Knowledge of digital technologies and industry trends. Problem-solving abilities to address project delivery constraints. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Yanbu, within the Eastern region. cde2919a7ae53629.description: About the Role Meituan is seeking a Keemart Expansion Manager to join its team in Dammam, Eastern region. cdea4ff7316fdcbb.description: About the Role Nice One is seeking an experienced, data-driven Senior Paid Marketing Specialist to lead and optimize paid digital marketing campaigns. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves managing campaigns across various channels to drive customer acquisition, revenue growth, and return on ad spend. The position requires strong analytical skills and hands-on platform expertise within a fast-paced marketing environment. Key Responsibilities Build, configure, launch, and manage paid advertising campaigns across platforms including Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Snapchat Ads, ensuring accurate targeting, bidding, tracking, and brand safety. Monitor and optimize campaigns daily, adjusting bids, budgets, audiences, creative rotations, and placements to meet ROAS and CAC targets. Develop and maintain audience segments, lookalike audiences, retargeting lists, and exclusion audiences, refining targeting based on performance and customer behavior. Coordinate with Brand and Creative teams to develop campaign creative briefs, review assets for alignment with specifications and brand guidelines, and manage revisions. Plan and execute A/B tests across creative, audiences, landing pages, bidding strategies, and messaging to identify performance improvements and document results. Monitor key paid media performance metrics such as ROAS, CAC, impressions, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and revenue contribution. Prepare regular performance summaries with insights and recommendations. Ensure correct tagging and configuration for accurate conversion tracking and attribution, escalating any discrepancies or technical issues promptly. Manage daily campaign spend and budget pacing, identifying deviations and escalating significant pacing issues for correction or reallocation. Ensure all campaigns comply with advertising platform policies, brand safety standards, and campaign requirements, escalating policy violations or risks. Collaborate with Brand, Creative, E-commerce, and other marketing teams to align campaigns with business objectives and promotional priorities. Stay informed on advertising platform updates, industry best practices, competitor activity, and emerging paid media trends relevant to GCC e-commerce. Proactively identify and escalate tracking failures, budget pacing issues, platform policy violations, and other campaign risks to the Team Leader. Identify and recommend opportunities for continuous improvement in paid channel performance, campaign setup, targeting, testing methodologies, and operational processes. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in paid digital marketing. Demonstrated expertise in managing paid campaigns across search, social media, and display channels. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and deliver measurable results. Hands-on experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Snapchat Ads. Work Environment This role is part of a cross-functional marketing team that emphasizes innovation, measurable growth, and continuous improvement. The work environment supports collaboration, accountability, and professional development, offering opportunities to expand expertise in paid media, analytics, and digital strategy. The position provides ownership of high-visibility campaigns that contribute directly to customer acquisition and business growth. Commitment to Inclusivity Nice One is committed to providing an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are available during the recruitment process upon request.

cd2d1c6fa110e64d.description: About the Role Majid Al Futtaim is seeking a Department Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading a team to deliver excellent customer service, managing department operations, and overseeing merchandising and stock to achieve sales targets within Majid Al Futtaim Lifestyle. Key Responsibilities Ensure store standards are maintained, including cleanliness, tidiness, and replenishment. Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly sales data to maximize sales performance. Lead the team in upholding high customer service standards and facilitate exceptional customer experiences by understanding company/brand CX standards, individual customer needs, and market trends. Resolve all customer complaints professionally and promptly, escalating to management when necessary. Ensure stock availability on the shop floor and arrange replenishment as required. Liaise with the management team to ensure all team members receive regular training relevant to the brand, company, and role. Maintain a positive working culture among colleagues and management. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience and demonstrate a proactive approach to team collaboration and customer satisfaction. Solicit customer feedback and ensure customer expectations are exceeded. cd86c2d69d6ee96a.description: About Afaq Q Tech General Trading Afaq Q Tech General Trading is seeking a Quality Associate to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role supports Anow, Amazon's quick commerce offering in Saudi Arabia, which delivers everyday essentials within 15 minutes from dark stores across the region. Role Overview The Quality Associate serves as the on-the-ground representative for Anow's quality standards across its store network and vendor base. This is a field-heavy position suitable for individuals who are detail-oriented, structured, and capable of ensuring adherence to high standards. Key Responsibilities Conduct scheduled and unannounced audits across Anow dark stores and vendor sites, covering operational processes, storage conditions, product quality, and compliance with Anow standards. Document audit findings in a structured format and produce clear, actionable reports for store managers, vendor partners, and internal stakeholders. Track corrective action plans following each audit and follow up with relevant teams to ensure gaps are closed within agreed timelines. Maintain a live view of quality performance across the store network, flagging recurring issues and escalating critical non-conformances promptly. Support the development and rollout of quality checklists, standard operating procedures, and training materials as standards evolve. Coordinate with Operations, Vendor Management, and Category teams to resolve quality issues that have upstream supply or process root causes. Contribute to periodic quality reviews by compiling audit data, identifying trends, and presenting findings to the team. Required Qualifications 0-1 year of relevant experience. Ability to identify gaps against established standards. Experience working with store and vendor teams to drive corrective actions. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and involves significant field work across Anow's dark stores and vendor sites. The position requires a proactive approach to maintaining and improving quality standards within a fast-paced quick commerce environment. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be discussed during the interview stage.

cdd46ccc4fecdaef.description: About the Role Genesys is seeking a Director, Solutions Consulting for the Middle East & Africa region. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves leading a geographically distributed team across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and South Africa. The Director will be responsible for shaping how Genesys helps organizations apply AI, cloud customer experience technology, and data to enhance customer and employee experiences. Role Context and Impact The Director, Solutions Consulting will own the regional strategy, capability, and execution, connecting customer priorities with Genesys solutions. This position requires partnering with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams across EMEA to influence go-to-market strategy, strengthen technical and business value in complex enterprise sales cycles, and accelerate sustainable regional growth. The role focuses on translating AI, Genesys Cloud, CCaaS, digital, and customer experience capabilities into practical solutions that address business priorities and support successful adoption. The Director will foster an AI-first culture of continuous innovation, enabling the team to experiment, learn, and convert emerging capabilities into customer and business value. Key Responsibilities Lead and develop a high-performing, geographically distributed Solutions Consulting team across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and South Africa, ensuring alignment, accountability, collaboration, and consistent execution. Own the end-to-end Solutions Consulting strategy for the region, aligning team capabilities, investment priorities, and execution with business objectives and customer needs. Drive an AI-first culture of continuous innovation to increase team agility, encourage informed experimentation, and convert emerging AI and automation capabilities into differentiated customer value. Partner with Sales and regional leaders to influence go-to-market strategy, strengthen complex enterprise opportunity execution, and improve technical and business value throughout the sales cycle. Elevate the team's impact as trusted advisors by advancing consultative engagement, solution design, technical expertise, and value-based storytelling. Drive alignment between customer priorities and tailored, data-driven solutions that demonstrate measurable business value and support successful adoption of Genesys Cloud, CCaaS, AI, digital, and customer experience capabilities. Strengthen strategic relationships with customers, partners, and the broader technology ecosystem through executive engagements, industry events, and conferences. Influence product and technology direction by translating regional customer needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics into actionable insights. Monitor team performance, sales enablement effectiveness, and Solutions Consulting business impact, using data to identify improvement opportunities. Advance team expertise across AI, Genesys Cloud, CCaaS, customer and employee experience, digital capabilities, and emerging technologies. Required Qualifications and Experience 10+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Technical Sales, Sales Engineering, or related customer-facing technical roles, including significant people leadership experience. Proven experience leading and developing high-performing, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries or markets. Demonstrated success partnering with Sales and senior leaders on complex enterprise opportunities, go-to-market priorities, and regional growth initiatives. Strong background in AI, CCaaS, customer experience, employee experience, digital technologies, and enterprise cloud software. Proven track record of guiding teams through technology and market change while fostering experimentation, continuous learning, and effective adoption of emerging capabilities. Exceptional executive communication, consultative engagement, and data-driven storytelling skills. Strong strategic judgment, problem-solving capability, and curiosity, with the ability to operate effectively across complex regional and cross-functional environments. Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and other functions. Strong understanding of enterprise software and AI technologies, including their impact on customer outcomes, employee experiences, and ways of working. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting enterprise customers and partners across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, South Africa, or the broader Middle East and Africa region. Experience representing a technology organization in executive customer engagements, partner discussions, industry events, or conferences. Working at Genesys Genesys provides AI-powered technology used by over 8,000 organizations globally, with more than 150 new AI features released in the last fiscal year. The company operates with a flexible-first culture, supporting a global team of nearly 7,000 employees. Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries.

cd0aad7e13a2f4f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الوردي عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية، بدءًا من التوظيف وحتى إدارة الأداء والامتثال القانوني. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية نشر الإعلانات الوظيفية، فرز السير الذاتية، إجراء المقابلات، واختيار الكفاءات المناسبة، بالإضافة إلى تجهيز عقود العمل. تنفيذ برامج تهيئة الموظفين الجدد وتعريفهم بسياسات الشركة وثقافتها، وإدارة إجراءات إنهاء الخدمات للمغادرين. التنسيق لإعداد كشوف الرواتب، متابعة الحضور والانصراف، وإدارة المزايا مثل التأمين الصحي والبدلات. تطبيق نماذج ومعايير تقييم أداء الموظفين بشكل دوري ومساعدة المدراء في تطوير الكفاءات. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية للموظفين وتنظيم ورش العمل والبرامج التطويرية. استقبال شكاوى واستفسارات الموظفين، والعمل على حل الخلافات وتطبيق اللوائح التأديبية بعدالة. متابعة الالتزام بقوانين العمل والأنظمة المعمول بها، وتحديث السجلات الوظيفية بانتظام عبر أنظمة إدارة الموارد البشرية (HRIS). إدارة شؤون الموظفين يتولى أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية مسؤولية إدارة ملفات الموظفين، ومتابعة البيانات الشخصية والوظيفية، بالإضافة إلى توثيق الإجازات والاستقالات. يضمن هذا الدور دقة واكتمال جميع سجلات الموظفين للامتثال للسياسات الداخلية واللوائح الخارجية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم عميق لأنظمة ولوائح العمل والقوانين المحلية ذات الصلة. القدرة على استخدام أنظمة إدارة الموارد البشرية (HRIS). بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يعمل أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق ديناميكي يدعم جميع أقسام الشركة لضمان بيئة عمل منظمة وفعالة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الوردي.

cd62c90e7bb312f3.description: About setec Middle East setec Middle East is part of setec, an international multidisciplinary engineering group that delivers complex and innovative projects globally. Based in Riyadh, the Middle East team is involved in major projects and programs across Saudi Arabia, with expertise in urban planning, urban design, infrastructure, environmental services, and PMC/PMO. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and involves supporting functions from recruitment and onboarding to employee administration and HR reporting. This role is suitable for an HR professional with 2-5 years of experience looking to develop broad HR expertise within a growing, multicultural, and international engineering environment. Key Responsibilities Support the preparation of employment contracts, HR letters, certificates, and other employee documentation. Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR databases. Support onboarding and offboarding processes, including preparing documentation and coordinating new employee arrivals. Assist with leave, medical insurance, and employee benefits administration. Help ensure HR documentation and processes comply with company policies and Saudi requirements. Support recruitment activities for positions in Saudi Arabia, including coordinating interviews, communication with candidates, and job postings. Collect and prepare HR information required for payroll processing. Coordinate with relevant internal teams and external providers as needed. Support employee data updates and administrative follow-up. Assist with HR reporting, dashboards, and workforce statistics. Assist with processes related to Iqama, visas, work permits, GOSI, and medical insurance. Support the team in maintaining HR compliance with Saudi regulations and nationalization requirements. Act as a first point of contact for employees on routine HR and administrative matters. Help employees navigate HR procedures and documentation. Support internal HR communication and employee initiatives. Contribute to training and development coordination when required. Candidate Requirements 2-5 years of experience in an HR role. Demonstrated ability to support a broad range of HR activities. Understanding of HR documentation, processes, and compliance. Experience with recruitment support and employee administration. This role offers broad exposure to HR operations and the opportunity to develop experience within an international and multicultural environment.

cdb80e0fa5871e67.description: About Synechron Synechron is a global consulting firm focused on digital transformation within businesses. The company delivers digital solutions through a combination of creativity and innovative technology. Synechron's services include Artificial Intelligence, Consulting, Digital, Cloud & DevOps, Data, and Software Engineering, primarily serving financial services and technology firms. With a global workforce of over 13,950 individuals across 52 offices in 20 countries, Synechron has been recognized with multiple employer awards over 20 years. The Role: Java Solution Architect Synechron is seeking a Java Solution Architect to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires over 10 years of experience and involves designing and implementing enterprise and product solutions. The architect will be responsible for aligning technology strategies with business objectives and leading large-scale enterprise solution delivery. Key Responsibilities Design complex systems across application, data, process, and infrastructure domains. Align technology strategies with business objectives. Lead and deliver large-scale enterprise solutions. Mentor and guide development teams and junior architects. Conduct resource estimation and capacity planning for CPUs, GPUs, memory, storage, and network bandwidth. Required Qualifications and Skills 15+ years of extensive experience in software development and enterprise/product solutions architecture and design. Extensive experience with Java, Spring, and Spring Boot Frameworks for backend, and Angular/React for frontend. Proficiency in Kafka, RabbitMQ, Restful Microservices, SOAP, SQL, database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL), OAuth2, JWT, Spring Security, Spring Data, Docker, and Kubernetes. Expertise in SDLC processes and methodologies. In-depth knowledge of infrastructure and networking architecture. Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, including architecture design and implementation. Experience with AI/ML technologies, frameworks, and platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, AWS SageMaker, or Google AI. Strong proficiency with C4 architecture modeling, particularly at container and component levels. Deep understanding of infrastructure design, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, and networking fundamentals. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on scalable, maintainable, and secure architectures. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities for working across diverse teams. cd6a6521ed4ed7b6.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة عمان تاورز عن حاجتها لموظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة سجلات المبيعات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. المهام الرئيسية يتولى موظف الصندوق المحاسبي مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة من المهام اليومية لضمان سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة ودقة. تشمل هذه المهام: عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية كل وردية عمل، مع التأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات النقدية أو عن طريق بطاقات الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة للعملاء. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وودود، وتلبية رغباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة، ويفضل أن تكون في وظيفة أمين صندوق أو ما شابهها. القدرة على التعامل مع المبالغ النقدية بدقة وسرعة. مهارات جيدة في التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب الدور مجموعة من المهارات الأساسية لضمان الأداء الفعال: الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع المعاملات المالية. مهارات التواصل الفعال والقدرة على بناء علاقات إيجابية مع العملاء. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. المرونة والقدرة على التكيف مع متطلبات العمل المتغيرة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء والزملاء. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

cd868f5d05f427dc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سنابل الطبية عن أخصائي مبيعات مستلزمات طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات البيع للمستلزمات الطبية، ومتابعة الأداء، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وتحويل الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد احتياجاتهم ومشكلاتهم. متابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة في المستقبل. تقييم أداء مندوبي المبيعات ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. اقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية لتحسين الأداء عند الضرورة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح هذه التقارير وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال مبيعات المستلزمات الطبية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي مبيعات المستلزمات الطبية في مؤسسة سنابل الطبية بمدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتطوير استراتيجيات فعالة في سوق المستلزمات الطبية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل مؤسسة سنابل الطبية، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

cd76b7483fe209ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على مراقبة وتطبيق متطلبات السلامة في المواقع، والعمل على منع الممارسات والظروف غير الآمنة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومطابقة للمعايير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الجولات التفتيشية الدورية في مواقع العمل لضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة. فحص معدات الوقاية الشخصية (PPE) ومعدات السلامة الأخرى للتأكد من صلاحيتها وكفاءتها. متابعة تصاريح العمل والتأكد من استيفائها للمتطلبات والإجراءات اللازمة قبل بدء أي نشاط. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي مخاطر محتملة أو ظروف غير آمنة يتم رصدها في الموقع. المشاركة في أنشطة التوعية بالسلامة وإجراء التحقيقات الأولية في الحوادث أو المخالفات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تطبيق ومراقبة متطلبات السلامة في بيئات العمل المختلفة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والإبلاغ عن المخاطر. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية ضمن فريق متخصص، حيث يساهم في الحفاظ على بيئة عمل آمنة ومنتجة من خلال المراقبة المستمرة والالتزام بالمعايير. الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في مجموعة بن لادن السعودية.

cd9aed16be69167f.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Lead Engineer – Steel Structure to join their team in Makkah, with work locations including Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves leading the design, analysis, coordination, and execution of steel structural engineering projects. The position requires extensive technical expertise in structural steel systems, strong leadership capabilities, and a collaborative approach to ensure successful project delivery within scope, budget, and schedule. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage steel structural engineering projects from conceptual design through detailed design, fabrication, erection, and final completion. Provide technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to structural engineers, designers, and project teams. Coordinate with project managers, architects, civil engineers, MEP disciplines, contractors, fabricators, and other stakeholders. Establish project deliverables, review requirements, and engineering priorities to support successful project execution. Monitor project progress, technical performance, deliverables, budgets, and schedules. Lead the analysis and design of structural steel systems, including buildings, industrial structures, stadiums, long-span structures, platforms, canopies, trusses, and pipe racks. Perform and review structural calculations for gravity, lateral, seismic, wind, thermal, fatigue, and other applicable loading conditions. Design and review steel members, frames, trusses, bracing systems, connections, base plates, and anchor bolts. Develop design criteria, structural schemes, load paths, design calculations, specifications, and engineering reports. Review and approve structural steel drawings, fabrication drawings, erection drawings, connection details, material specifications, and technical submittals. Utilize advanced structural analysis and design software to develop efficient, safe, and constructible solutions. Ensure design interfaces are properly coordinated with foundations, concrete structures, architectural elements, equipment, and building services. Ensure steel structure designs comply with applicable local, national, and international codes and standards, including AISC, ASCE, Eurocodes, BS standards, and AWS. Lead design reviews, interdisciplinary coordination reviews, constructability reviews, value engineering exercises, and risk assessments. Coordinate with steel fabricators and contractors regarding fabrication methods, connection details, tolerances, material requirements, and erection sequencing. Conduct site visits and inspections to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements. Liaise with clients, contractors, fabricators, consultants, suppliers, and regulatory authorities to resolve technical issues. Prepare and present technical reports, design reviews, progress updates, calculations, and project documentation to stakeholders. Identify and implement innovative, economical, and constructible steel structural solutions. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 18 years of experience in structural steel engineering, including significant experience in technical leadership roles. Extensive experience in the analysis, design, detailing, fabrication, and erection of steel structures. Strong knowledge of structural steel behavior, member design, connection design, stability, load paths, structural systems, and constructability. Proficiency in structural analysis and design software, such as ******, SAP2000, ETABS, RAM, or Tekla Structural Designer. Strong knowledge of applicable structural design codes and standards, including AISC, ASCE, Eurocodes, BS standards, and AWS. Experience reviewing structural steel fabrication drawings, erection drawings, connection details, and technical submittals. Understanding of steel fabrication processes, welding, bolting, inspection, testing, tolerances, corrosion protection, fire protection, and erection methodologies. Experience with complex steel structures, long-span systems, industrial structures, stadiums, large public venues, or major infrastructure projects is preferred. Professional engineering registration or equivalent certification is preferred. Required Skills Strong project management, technical coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. Proven leadership and team management capabilities. Analytical, organized, and detail-oriented mindset. Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic project environment. Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, clients, contractors, fabricators, and consultants. Work Environment The role is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, covering projects in both Jeddah and Makkah. This is a full-time position within a collaborative team environment, requiring coordination with various internal and external stakeholders.

cdf921af1a0eee85.description: Job description Stage - Stratégie d'intégration de données plaques et de connexion aux bases de données F/H Stage 5 à 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet SAFRAN Ceramics est une filiale du groupe SAFRAN dont la mission est de développer les matériaux et les produits en composites à matrice céramique (CMC) pour les applications du groupe. L'introduction des CMC dans les moteurs d'avion est devenue une réalité et reste un enjeu majeur pour la prochaine génération de moteurs. En effet, ces matériaux ont une très bonne tenue thermomécanique aux hautes températures et une faible densité. Ils sont donc les candidats idéaux pour remplacer les métaux dans les parties chaudes des moteurs d'avions. Les différentes pièces élaborées en CMC doivent résister aux sollicitations thermomécaniques du moteur, ce qui nécessite une maîtrise du procédé d'élaboration et une connaissance fine du comportement du matériau. Pour répondre à ces exigences, des plaques en CMC sont fabriquées en vue d'en extraire des éprouvettes de caractérisation. Lors de la fabrication des plaques et la caractérisation des éprouvettes, d'importantes quantités de données sont générées. Celles-ci proviennent de différents canaux et sont centralisées dans un operational data store (ODS). Un DataWareHouse (DWH) et un DataMart (DTM) permettent ensuite successivement de filtrer et réorganiser ces données en fonction de l'utilisation souhaitée. Ces trois briques constituent la DataTech. Au cours de leur fabrication, ces plaques sont contrôlées par différents moyens non destructifs (stéréovision, tomographie, thermographie…) pour permettre de mieux les définir. Le stage s'inscrit dans ce contexte et les missions s'articuleront autour de trois axes principaux : 1/ Automatiser la récupération des données continues liées à la fabrication des plaques. La centralisation au sein d'un même référentiel spatial permettra de mettre en correspondance les informations issues des plaques et des éprouvettes. 2/ Structurer les données récupérées et les intégrer dans le flux existant (DataTech…). 3/ Générer les données de sortie et la visualisation associée. Vous serez intégré-e au sein du département matériau et serez amené-e à interagir avec différents métiers de SAFRAN CERAMICS, notamment avec les équipes de développement matériau et procédé (textiles), de Contrôle Non Destructif (CND) et de gestion de la Data. Vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les outils existants pour mener à bien son projet. Vous serez également amené-e à participer aux points d'avancement et à présenter ses résultats sous forme de rapports et de présentations. - Parlons de vous : Vous êtes étudiant-e en Master ou école d'ingénieur avec une spécialité en Data engineering. Vous avez des connaissances en programmation (Python, SQL, VBA, R) / Bases de données / Matériaux. Vous êtes rigoureuse ou rigoureux, méthodique, organisé-e et autonome, vous présentez un intérêt pour découvrir des domaines de recherche de pointe. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma
